text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a field of computer science that creates machines able to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. These tasks include learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a part of AI that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to process complex information. Today, AI is used in many areas of daily life. For example, it helps with voice assistants, online recommendations, medical diagnosis, and self-driving cars.
